story_clusters.headline: 'What's going on...?': Congress jumps at BJP leader P Muralidhar Rao's cryptic X post over student protests
story_clusters.summary: Student protests have taken place in Delhi, resulting in some police officers being injured. Senior leaders from the RSS and BJP, including Mohan Bhagwat, Murli Manohar Joshi, and Muralidhar Rao, have made remarks on the protests. The Rajya Sabha continued its proceedings despite opposition protests over the police crackdown in Delhi.

articles.title: Anthropic says it never sought ban on open-weight AI models; CEO calls for chip controls, safety testing
articles.summary: Anthropic, an AI company led by CEO Dario Amodei, clarified it does not support banning open-weight AI models. Instead, Amodei called for policy efforts to focus on restricting advanced AI chips from authoritarian regimes, limiting industrial-scale model distillation, and mandating safety testing for powerful AI systems. The company's stance reflects ongoing global discussions about AI regulation and export controls.
